Chapter 608 - 608 Attacked; Goodbye!

Chapter 608 - 608 Attacked; Goodbye!

608 Attacked; Goodbye!

Lin Fan had no idea what was going on in the real world.

After he was full, he drew a circle of 200 square meters, took out his sleeping bag, and went to sleep comfortably.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Just like usual.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam found a direction and started walking.

Not long after, Lin Fan heard a notification in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve been in the Otherworld for 744 hours. You’ve obtained Beginner Time Spell.]

Instantly, countless flowing time particles appeared in Lin Fan’s vision.

Lin Fan willed the time particles to freeze.

The leaves that were about to fall, the big bird that was flying in the air, the small snake that was crawling in the distance, and Sam, who had just taken a step…The space seemed to have been frozen, and everything instantly stopped moving.

No!

It was not only this space, but the same thing occurred on Earth.

Lin Fan picked up a leaf in the air and tossed it casually.

The fallen leaf seemed to have frozen in the air again.

Lin Fan’s lips curled up. Not a bad ability!

Then, his mind moved slightly.

In the next moment, the time particles resumed flowing.

The leaves slowly fell, the big bird in the sky continued to fly, the little snake kept slithering, and Sam took a firm step forward…

Everything returned to normal.

The people watching the live broadcast on Earth were still eating and sending comments…

No one noticed anything unusual.

In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.

In the past few days, Lin Fan had encountered a few ferocious beasts.

However, he did not even need to make a move. All of them were taken care of by the Heavenly Hound.

In addition, Lin Fan had obtained 800 Constitution points and 600 spiritual energy points from the system.

…

The hero of Li Country was called Eugene Giles.

He was a sniper from a dark organization.

After Eugene Giles was selected, he prepared two sniper rifles and a large bag of bullets.

Most of the heroes who arrived in the Otherworld were in a sorry state.

When they encountered ferocious beasts, they would either be eaten or flee in panic.

At the same time, they prayed silently in their hearts that they would not encounter any more ferocious beasts.

Eugene Giles was completely different.

After he arrived in the Otherworld, he found a high vantage point and used his superb shooting ability to shoot the eye of a giant lion with a snake tail. He obtained 20 points of spiritual energy.

Immediately, Eugene Giles’ perception and shooting ability were greatly improved.

This allowed Eugene Giles to experience the benefits of hunting.

Therefore, he began to actively hunt fierce beasts.

Later on, not only did he hunt ferocious beasts, he also chose to kill people when he met them.

This was because most humans had resources on them.

In a month, Eugene Giles had killed four beasts and five humans.

Today, as usual, he found a hidden spot.

Then, like a wooden stake, he stood there motionless.

…

In Li Country’s live broadcast room.

Barry: [I wonder if Eugene Giles will encounter a ferocious beast today.]

Huston: [It’s just that… Eugene Giles likes to kill people. He’s a little scary.]

Norton: [Scary? This is the law of the jungle! Survival of the fittest!]

Job: [That’s right! In addition, I like seeing him kill people. One shot! Bang! He’s so handsome!]

Klaus: [Eugene Giles, you’re the best! You are our hero!]

Hero?

That was right!

Eugene Giles was indeed a hero.

After he killed the four beasts, Li Nation’s land area, oil, ores, and air quality had all increased.

At this moment, Eugene Giles, who was originally motionless, suddenly curled his lips.

“There’s another prey,” he whispered.

A tall and handsome figure, a brownish-skinned man, and an animal that looked like a wolf or dog appeared in his scope.

They were Lin Fan, Sam, and the Heavenly Hound.

“Not bad!” Eugene Giles said. “There’s a lot of food in the guy’s backpack. There’s even a dog. It seems… I can eat my fill for a long time.”

…

In Li Country’s live broadcast room.

The originally excited atmosphere immediately changed.

Xiu Mu: [It’s Lin Fan!]

MAKING: [Wait, Eugene Giles, what are you doing?]

John: [Eugene Giles, don’t! Don’t shoot!]

Armstrong: [Don’t shoot!]

…

The entire screen was filled with warnings.

That was because they all knew just how powerful and terrifying Lin Fan was.

He was a true god.

Guns would probably be useless on him.

Once Eugene angered the other party, the consequences would definitely be terrifying.

…

All these attempts to stop and persuade Eugene were obviously useless.

Eugene’s lips curled up slightly. “Goodbye!”

He pulled the trigger three times.

Three golden bullets pierced through the air and shot toward the heads of Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam.

When the bullets were only half a meter away from them, Lin Fan suddenly raised his head.

It was also at this moment that the three bullets froze in the air.

No!

It was not just the bullets that stopped in the air.

The Heavenly Hound that took a step forward, the leaves above its head, and the big bird that was flying in the air… all stopped in the air.

[Skill: Beginner Time Spell!]

Lin Fan looked at Eugene Giles and said, “Killing people with guns?”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan slowly turned the bullets in the air.

It was also at this moment…

The front leg of the Heavenly Hound continued to move forward, the fallen leaves slowly drifted down, and the big bird continued to fly…

The golden bullets flew back to where they came from.

Three soft sounds were heard.

Three bullets simultaneously pierced through Eugene Giles’ head, who was hiding in the distance. His entire head instantly exploded. Red and white shot out, making it extremely bloody.

“Master, there seems to be gunshots. Is there a battle?” Sam asked.

As he spoke, he kept looking around.

Lin Fan smiled. “You heard wrong. Let’s go.”

He did not stop and walked ahead leisurely.

The Heavenly Hound looked at the spot where Eugene Giles had fallen and followed behind Lin Fan.

“Did I hear wrong?” Sam scratched his head.

Then, he caught up to Lin Fan.

…

On the other hand, an emotionless voice sounded in everyone’s ears.

[Eugene Giles has died. Li Country’s desert area has increased by 20%.]

Suddenly, a wisp of dense black gas spread out from the Void Gate.

In an instant, a city in Li Country turned into a desert. Countless buildings collapsed like broken shadows.

Some people who lived in the city stood in the scorching desert with blank expressions.

A gust of wind blew many people into a mouthful of sand. Some were even buried in the boundless desert.

Awe-inspiring, terrifying!

Despair!
